create-table-with-header-and-data-rows.title: Create a Table with Header in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf
create-table-with-header-and-data-rows.description: Demonstrates how to programmatically create a PDF, add a table with header formatting, populate rows and cells, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf for .NET.

insert-table-into-pdf.title: Insert Table into Existing PDF Page
insert-table-into-pdf.description: Shows how to create an Aspose.Pdf.Table, apply basic styling, and place it at a specific X/Y location on a chosen page of an existing PDF document.

auto-fit-table-columns-to-content.title: AutoFit Table Columns to Content in PDF
auto-fit-table-columns-to-content.description: Demonstrates how to set ColumnAdjustment to AutoFitToContent on an Aspose.Pdf.Table so that column widths automatically adjust to the cell contents before saving the PDF.

stretch-table-to-page-width.title: AutoFit Table to Page Width in PDF
stretch-table-to-page-width.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF document with a table that automatically stretches to fill the page width using Aspose.Pdf's auto‑fit feature.

insert-svg-image-into-table-cell.title: Insert SVG Image into PDF Table Cell
insert-svg-image-into-table-cell.description: Shows how to embed an SVG file into a table cell of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by creating an Image object and adding it to the cell's paragraph collection.

embed-html-in-table-cell.title: Embed HTML in PDF Table Cell
embed-html-in-table-cell.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a table, and inserting an HtmlFragment into a cell to render formatted HTML content alongside plain text.

insert-page-break-after-table-row.title: Create Page Break Between Table Rows
insert-page-break-after-table-row.description: Shows how to split a table across multiple pages by adding a new page after specific rows using Aspose.Pdf's Document, Page, Table, and related classes.

render-table-on-new-pdf-page.title: Render Table on a New PDF Page
render-table-on-new-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF document, add a new page, build a table with header and data rows, and place the table on the page using Aspose.Pdf for C#.

merge-table-cells-colspan.title: Merge Table Cells Using ColSpan in PDF
merge-table-cells-colspan.description: Demonstrates how to merge three adjacent columns into a single cell in an Aspose.Pdf table by setting the Cell.ColSpan property.

merge-table-cells-vertically-rowspan.title: Merge Table Cells Using RowSpan in PDF
merge-table-cells-vertically-rowspan.description: Shows how to create a tagged PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and merge a cell across two rows by setting the TableTDElement.RowSpan property.

set-custom-cell-margins-in-pdf-table.title: Set Cell Margins in a PDF Table
set-custom-cell-margins-in-pdf-table.description: Shows how to configure individual cell margins using MarginInfo and apply it to a table cell in a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

set-default-cell-padding-for-pdf-table.title: Set Default Cell Padding for a Tagged PDF Table
set-default-cell-padding-for-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to define uniform cell padding for a table in a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TableElement and MarginInfo.

get-rendered-table-width-after-layout.title: Get Rendered Table Width After Layout
get-rendered-table-width-after-layout.description: Demonstrates how to force layout of an Aspose.Pdf table, then obtain its calculated width using column definitions or page width after layout.

import-datatable-into-pdf-table.title: Import DataTable into PDF Table
import-datatable-into-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to import an in‑memory DataTable into an Aspose.Pdf Table and save the result as a PDF document.

import-filtered-dataview-into-pdf-table.title: Import Filtered DataView into PDF Table
import-filtered-dataview-into-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates creating a DataView with a row filter, importing the filtered data (including column headers) into an Aspose.Pdf.Table using ImportDataView, and saving the result as a PDF document.

create-pdf-table-from-datatable.title: Generate PDF Table from a DataTable
create-pdf-table-from-datatable.description: Shows how to populate a DataTable, import it into an Aspose.Pdf Table, and save the table as a PDF document.

check-table-break-across-pages.title: Check If a PDF Table Breaks Across Pages
check-table-break-across-pages.description: Loads a PDF, accesses its tagged content, finds the first table element and uses the TableElement.IsBroken property to determine if the table spans multiple pages.

mark-table-header-enable-column-repeat.title: Repeat Table Header Column in Tagged PDF
mark-table-header-enable-column-repeat.description: Demonstrates how to mark a column as a header (TH) and enable repeating header rows and columns on each new page in a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf, with reflection for version‑agnostic flag setting.

extract-tables-from-pdf.title: Extract Tables from PDF using TableAbsorber
extract-tables-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF document, use Aspose.Pdf.TableAbsorber to detect tables, and iterate over the extracted tables to obtain page numbers, row counts and bounding rectangles.

replace-table-in-pdf.title: Replace Absorbed Table with New Table in PDF
replace-table-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates locating an absorbed table using TableAbsorber and replacing it with a newly created Table at the same position in a PDF document.

remove-first-table-from-pdf.title: Remove a Table from PDF using TableAbsorber
remove-first-table-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to detect tables in a PDF with TableAbsorber, remove a specific table, and save the modified document.

remove-all-tables-from-pdf.title: Remove All Tables from a PDF Document
remove-all-tables-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, find Table objects in the page's Paragraphs collection, remove them, and save the updated document.

batch-add-table-with-logo-to-pdfs.title: Add Company Logo Table to PDFs in Batch
batch-add-table-with-logo-to-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, insert a table containing a logo image and company name on the first page of each document, and save the updated PDFs.

apply-different-autofit-behaviors-to-tab.title: Apply Different AutoFitBehavior Settings to Tables in a PDF
apply-different-autofit-behaviors-to-tab.description: Demonstrates how to set distinct ColumnAdjustment (AutoFitToContent and AutoFitToWindow) for separate tables within the same PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

set-cell-background-color-in-pdf-table.title: Set Background Color for a PDF Table Cell
set-cell-background-color-in-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged table in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and apply a background color to a specific table cell before saving the document.

add-solid-border-to-pdf-table.title: Apply Solid Border to PDF Table
add-solid-border-to-pdf-table.description: Creates a PDF document, adds a table, and sets a solid 1‑point border around the entire table using Aspose.Pdf's BorderInfo.

insert-image-into-table-cell.title: Insert External Image into PDF Table Cell
insert-image-into-table-cell.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF, adding a table, and placing an external image file into a table cell using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-image-into-pdf-table-cell.title: Insert Image from Memory Stream into PDF Table Cell
insert-image-into-pdf-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to load an image into a MemoryStream and embed it into a table cell of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-text-fragment-to-table-cell.title: Add Text with Specific Font to a PDF Table Cell
add-text-fragment-to-table-cell.description: Shows how to create a table in a PDF, insert a TextFragment with a chosen font and size into a cell, and save the updated document.

add-centered-paragraph-to-table-cell.title: Add Centered Text to a PDF Table Cell
add-centered-paragraph-to-table-cell.description: Demonstrates loading an existing PDF, creating a table, adding a cell, and inserting a centered paragraph (TextFragment) into that cell using Aspose.Pdf.

set-cell-vertical-alignment-middle.title: Set Cell Vertical Alignment to Middle in PDF Table
set-cell-vertical-alignment-middle.description: Demonstrates how to create a table in a PDF, add a cell, and set its vertical alignment to middle using Aspose.Pdf.

center-table-horizontally.title: Center Align Table in PDF
center-table-horizontally.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add a table, and horizontally center the table using Aspose.Pdf's Table.HorizontalAlignment property.

offset-table-left-margin.title: Offset Table from Left Margin in PDF
offset-table-left-margin.description: Demonstrates how to create a table in a PDF and shift it from the page's left edge by setting Table.Margin.Left to a specific point value.

split-table-across-pdf-pages.title: Enable Table Splitting Across PDF Pages
split-table-across-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to allow a table to automatically break across multiple PDF pages by setting Table.IsBroken to true.

prevent-table-splitting.title: Disable Table Splitting in PDF
prevent-table-splitting.description: Shows how to prevent an Aspose.Pdf table from breaking across pages by setting Table.IsBroken to false and inserting the table into a PDF document.

calculate-remaining-page-space-add-table.title: Add Table Within Remaining Page Space in a PDF
calculate-remaining-page-space-add-table.description: Demonstrates how to compute the usable vertical space on a PDF page after accounting for margins and existing text, then creates a table that fits within that space.

create-fixed-width-table-pdf.title: Create Fixed-Width Table in PDF
create-fixed-width-table-pdf.description: Shows how to set a table's total width to 500 points by using the ColumnWidths property and add the table to a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

set-table-width-percentage.title: Set Table Width to 80% of Page
set-table-width-percentage.description: Shows how to calculate column widths so a table occupies 80% of the page width and assign them via Table.ColumnWidths.

map-datatable-columns-to-pdf-table.title: Map DataTable Columns to PDF Table Using Column Mapping
map-datatable-columns-to-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to map DataTable column names to different PDF table column names with a dictionary and manually populate an Aspose.Pdf Table.

create-pdf-table-from-filtered-dataview.title: Filter DataView Rows and Import to DataTable
create-pdf-table-from-filtered-dataview.description: Shows how to apply a RowFilter on a DataView to keep rows where Amount > 100 and then import those rows into a new DataTable.

populate-pdf-table-from-linq-data.title: Create Tagged PDF Table from LINQ Query
populate-pdf-table-from-linq-data.description: Demonstrates converting a LINQ query result into a DataTable and using Aspose.Pdf to build a tagged PDF table populated with that data.

add-table-to-specific-pdf-page.title: Add Table to Specific PDF Page
add-table-to-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to insert a table into a chosen page of a PDF by accessing the page via its index and adding the table to the page's paragraph collection using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-table-after-paragraph.title: Insert Table After Specific Paragraph in Tagged PDF
insert-table-after-paragraph.description: Demonstrates how to locate a paragraph in a tagged PDF, create a table element, and insert the table immediately after the found paragraph.

insert-table-before-first-image.title: Insert Table Before First Image in PDF
insert-table-before-first-image.description: Shows how to detect an image on a PDF page and insert a table before it by adding the table at the start of the page's paragraph collection.

create-repeating-table-header.title: Create Repeating Table Header in a Tagged PDF
create-repeating-table-header.description: Demonstrates how to add a table with a header row that repeats on each new page using Aspose.Pdf's tagged PDF API.

style-table-header-row-pdf.title: Style Table Header Row with Background Color and Bold Font
style-table-header-row-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF table using Aspose.Pdf and apply distinct styling to the header row by setting a background color and bold font for each header cell.

add-table-footer-to-pdf.title: Add Footer Row to Tagged PDF Table
add-table-footer-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a table with header, body, and a footer row using the Tagged Content API, and ensures the footer repeats on each page when the table spans multiple pages.

create-pdf-table-alternating-row-colors.title: Apply Alternating Row Background Colors to PDF Table
create-pdf-table-alternating-row-colors.description: The example loads a tagged PDF, locates the first table, and sets alternating background colors for each row's cells, then saves the modified document.

insert-hyperlink-into-table-cell.title: Insert Hyperlink into Table Cell with LinkAnnotation
insert-hyperlink-into-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged PDF table, add a paragraph to a cell, and overlay a LinkAnnotation that turns the cell text into a clickable hyperlink.

add-checkbox-form-field-in-table-cell.title: Add Checkbox Form Field Inside a Table Cell
add-checkbox-form-field-in-table-cell.description: Demonstrates how to create a tagged PDF table and place a CheckboxField form element inside one of its cells using Aspose.Pdf.

add-radio-button-group-in-table-cell.title: Add Radio Button Group Inside Table Cell
add-radio-button-group-in-table-cell.description: Demonstrates creating a radio‑button group with Aspose.Pdf.Forms.RadioButtonField, adding options, positioning them within a table cell, and saving the PDF.

export-pdf-table-structure-to-json.title: Export PDF Table Structure to JSON
export-pdf-table-structure-to-json.description: Shows how to read tagged tables from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract rows, cells and their alternative text, and write the structure to a JSON file.

export-pdf-table-to-csv.title: Export PDF Table Data to CSV
export-pdf-table-to-csv.description: Shows how to read tables from a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf, extract each cell's text, and write the rows to a CSV file.

serialize-pdf-table-to-xml.title: Serialize PDF Table to XML
serialize-pdf-table-to-xml.description: Creates a PDF document with a table using Aspose.Pdf, then converts the table's rows and cells into a custom XML representation and saves both files.

render-xml-table-to-pdf.title: Create PDF Table from XML Definition
render-xml-table-to-pdf.description: Loads a table definition from an XML file, builds a tagged logical table structure with Aspose.Pdf, and saves it as a PDF document.

count-tables-in-pdf.title: Count Tables in a PDF using TableAbsorber
count-tables-in-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, apply TableAbsorber to extract table structures, and obtain the number of detected tables.

extract-table-coordinates-from-pdf.title: Extract Table Coordinates from PDF
extract-table-coordinates-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to locate tables in a PDF and retrieve each table's bounding rectangle coordinates.

extract-text-from-pdf-tables.title: Extract Text from PDF Tables using TableAbsorber
extract-text-from-pdf-tables.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to locate tables in a PDF and retrieve the concatenated text from each cell.

replace-text-in-pdf-table-cells.title: Replace Table Cell Text in Tagged PDF
replace-text-in-pdf-table-cells.description: Shows how to locate table cells in a tagged PDF, search for a specific keyword, and replace the cell's content with new text using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-column-from-pdf-table.title: Remove a Specific Column from a PDF Table
remove-column-from-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to delete a column from an Aspose.Pdf Table by removing the corresponding Cell objects from each Row and updating the column widths.

insert-new-column-into-pdf-table.title: Insert Column into PDF Table
insert-new-column-into-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to add a new column to a PDF table by inserting header, body, and footer cells using Aspose.Pdf's logical structure API.

reorder-pdf-table-columns.title: Reorder Table Columns in PDF
reorder-pdf-table-columns.description: Shows how to change the column order of a tagged PDF table by creating a new TableElement and copying cells according to a specified index sequence.

adjust-table-column-widths-proportionall.title: Set Proportional Column Widths in a Tagged PDF Table
adjust-table-column-widths-proportionall.description: Shows how to calculate column widths as percentages of the total width and apply them to a TableElement in a tagged PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-minimum-column-width.title: Create PDF Table with Minimum Column Widths
set-minimum-column-width.description: Shows how to build a tagged PDF table using Aspose.Pdf, set explicit column widths, and define minimum column widths to prevent columns from becoming too narrow.

set-maximum-table-column-width.title: Limit Table Column Widths in PDF
set-maximum-table-column-width.description: Shows how to enforce a maximum column width for a table in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, preventing columns from expanding beyond a defined point size.

add-auto-numbered-column-to-pdf-table.title: Add Auto‑Numbered Column to a PDF Table
add-auto-numbered-column-to-pdf-table.description: Loads an existing PDF, creates a tagged table, and populates it with data while automatically numbering each row in the first column.

add-table-with-semi-transparent-backgrou.title: Add Background Color with Opacity to an Accessible PDF Table
add-table-with-semi-transparent-backgrou.description: Demonstrates creating an accessible table in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API and applying a semi‑transparent background color.

set-table-z-index.title: Set Table Z‑Index on PDF Page
set-table-z-index.description: Demonstrates how to assign a Z‑index to a Table in an existing PDF so that it appears above other page elements, using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-table-into-paragraph-collection.title: Add Table After Paragraph in PDF
insert-table-into-paragraph-collection.description: Demonstrates how to insert a paragraph of text and then add a table to a PDF page using Aspose.PDF, and save the modified document.

render-table-high-dpi-images.title: Render High‑DPI Images in a PDF Table
render-table-high-dpi-images.description: Demonstrates how to insert high‑resolution images into a PDF table by enabling image resolution handling and keeping image streams alive until the document is saved.

create-pdf-report-multiple-tables.title: Create PDF Report with Multiple Tables
create-pdf-report-multiple-tables.description: Shows how to generate a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf, add titled tables from DataTable objects on separate pages, and save the report.

create-pdf-table-dynamic-row-count.title: Create Dynamic Table in Tagged PDF
create-pdf-table-dynamic-row-count.description: Shows how to count source records and generate a tagged PDF table with a dynamic number of rows using Aspose.Pdf.

conditional-formatting-table-cells.title: Conditional Formatting of Table Cells in PDF
conditional-formatting-table-cells.description: Shows how to create a tagged PDF table with Aspose.Pdf and apply conditional formatting by setting a background color for cells whose numeric values exceed a defined threshold.

rotate-text-in-table-cell.title: Rotate Text Inside a PDF Table Cell
rotate-text-in-table-cell.description: Shows how to rotate text within a table cell of a PDF by setting the TextState.Rotation property on a TextFragment using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-table-90-degrees-pdf.title: Render a 90° Rotated Table in PDF
rotate-table-90-degrees-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to rotate an entire PDF page by 90 degrees and add a table with cells to the rotated page using Aspose.Pdf.

detect-merged-cells-in-pdf-tables.title: Detect Merged Cells in PDF Tables using TableAbsorber
detect-merged-cells-in-pdf-tables.description: Loads a PDF, extracts tables with TableAbsorber, and examines each cell's RowSpan and ColumnSpan (via reflection) to identify merged cells.

replace-merged-table-cells.title: Replace Merged Table Cells with Separate Cells in PDF
replace-merged-table-cells.description: Demonstrates how to remove a merged cell from a PDF table and create a new table with individual cells using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content API.

add-footnote-references-to-table-cells.title: Add Footnote References to Table Cells in a Tagged PDF
add-footnote-references-to-table-cells.description: The example loads an existing PDF, creates a tagged table, inserts superscript footnote markers into table cells, adds matching footnote paragraphs at the end of the document, and saves the updated PDF.

insert-table-at-specific-position.title: Insert Table at Specific Coordinates in PDF
insert-table-at-specific-position.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a Table, positioning it using absolute Left and Top coordinates, adding header and data rows, and saving the modified document.

right-align-table-pdf.title: Align Table to Right Margin in PDF
right-align-table-pdf.description: Shows how to align a table to the right margin of a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf by setting the HorizontalAlignment property and adjusting margins.

set-table-border-thickness.title: Set Table Border Thickness in PDF
set-table-border-thickness.description: Shows how to create a PDF document with a table and configure a 2‑point border for all cells using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-double-border-to-pdf-table.title: Add Double Border Table to Tagged PDF
apply-double-border-to-pdf-table.description: The sample opens an existing PDF, enables tagged content, creates a table element with a double‑like border by setting BorderInfo width, fills header and data cells, and saves the modified document.

add-multiline-text-to-table-cell.title: Add Multiline Text to a Table Cell in PDF
add-multiline-text-to-table-cell.description: Demonstrates creating a table in a PDF, adding a header row, and inserting multiline text into a cell by adding separate TextFragment objects with line‑break fragments.

add-list-items-in-table-cell.title: Add List to Table Cell in Tagged PDF
add-list-items-in-table-cell.description: Shows how to create a tagged PDF table and insert a bullet list inside a table cell using Aspose.Pdf's tagging API.

extract-pdf-tables-to-datatable.title: Extract PDF Tables to DataTable with TableAbsorber
extract-pdf-tables-to-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to locate tables in a PDF, extract cell text, and populate a .NET DataTable for further processing.

set-custom-row-height-in-pdf-table.title: Set Fixed Row Height in PDF Table
set-custom-row-height-in-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to create a table in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and assign a fixed height to a specific row.

auto-fit-table-row-height.title: Auto‑Fit Table Row Height in PDF
auto-fit-table-row-height.description: Demonstrates how to let a table row automatically adjust its height to fit wrapped content by using the default auto‑fit behavior in Aspose.Pdf.

set-fixed-row-height-for-pdf-table-rows.title: Set Fixed Row Height for Table Rows
set-fixed-row-height-for-pdf-table-rows.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF table with Aspose.Pdf, add rows and cells, and apply a uniform fixed height to every row before saving the document.

render-wide-table-landscape.title: Create Landscape PDF with Wide Table
render-wide-table-landscape.description: Shows how to set a PDF page to landscape orientation and add a wide table that fits within the page using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-page-add-table.title: Rotate PDF Page and Insert Table
rotate-page-add-table.description: Demonstrates how to rotate a PDF page by 90 degrees and then add a simple two‑column table to the rotated page using Aspose.Pdf.

detect-extract-tables-rotated-pages.title: Detect Tables on Rotated PDF Pages with TableAbsorber
detect-extract-tables-rotated-pages.description: The example loads a PDF, checks each page's rotation, and uses TableAbsorber to locate and report tables only on rotated pages.

remove-tables-containing-keyword.title: Remove Tables Containing a Keyword from a PDF
remove-tables-containing-keyword.description: Loads a PDF, scans its tagged structure for table elements, checks each cell for a specified keyword (case‑insensitive), and removes any table that contains the keyword before saving the result.

create-pdf-table-auto-fit-columns.title: Auto‑Fit Table Columns in PDF
create-pdf-table-auto-fit-columns.description: Shows how to create a PDF with a table and automatically adjust column widths to fit the content using Aspose.Pdf.

add-shadow-effect-to-table.title: Add Shadow Effect to Table in PDF
add-shadow-effect-to-table.description: Shows how to simulate a shadow for a table by drawing a semi‑transparent FloatingBox behind the table and positioning it with absolute coordinates.

add-numbered-list-in-table-cell.title: Create Numbered List Inside a Table Cell
add-numbered-list-in-table-cell.description: Shows how to add a numbered list to a table cell by creating paragraph elements with list numbers using Aspose.Pdf's tagging features.

multiple-tables-auto-fit-pdf.title: Create PDF with Multiple Tables and Different AutoFit Settings
multiple-tables-auto-fit-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add several tables to a PDF, each bound to a separate DataTable and using its own AutoFit configuration (auto‑fit to window vs. custom column widths).

batch-replace-tables-in-multiple-pdfs.title: Batch Replace Tables in Multiple PDFs
batch-replace-tables-in-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to iterate through a folder of PDF files, locate each table on every page using TableAbsorber, remove the original tables, and insert replacement tables.

add-table-with-background-color.title: Add Gradient Background to PDF Table
add-table-with-background-color.description: Shows how to create a table in a PDF and apply a linear gradient brush to its background using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-tables-to-csv__v2.title: Extract PDF Tables to CSV using TableAbsorber
extract-pdf-tables-to-csv__v2.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's TableAbsorber to extract tables from each page of a PDF and save them as CSV files, handling cell text concatenation and CSV escaping.
